reviews.comment: CHEN 482 during Spring Semester. Prof Sun provides great lectures. Homeworks are fine, some are quantitative and other qualitative. Qualitative are directly from slides. Quantitative are from examples. Exams are a combination of both. Final is not cumulative. There are random in-class assignments that do matter for your grade. Prof Sun is chill.

Dr. Sun cares about her students and the material. Lectures can be a little dull esp if you have taken other bio courses. Overall grading was fair, no curveballs on exams. Class notes are not complete and there are easy attendance quizzes.

Dr. Qing Sun is very caring. She wants everyone to learn and do well in her class. Also, she is really good at giving real-life applications to the material. Her class is pretty straightforward - if you listen to what you say you should do well in the class.
